activities.title: Draft your Lab 4 outline with AI, then fix it
activities.intro: Use Copilot, Gemini, Canva's AI or any assistant your office allows. AI drafts the outline; you make it true and yours.

items: Copy the prompt from the slide or the chat. Fill in your role, with no real names of others.
Paste it into the AI assistant and get the outline.
Highlight anything you didn't do or can't prove.
Replace it with your real example.
Remove every [placeholder].
Type your slide titles into your Lab 4 file.

blocks.prompt: Paste one line you changed (AI said… I changed it to…)
From the sample AI draft: what do you keep, and what do you replace?
items: The six-slide structure
[Insert Name]
Advanced Excel macros
Productivity increased by 50%
Microsoft Access databases

blocks.prompt: Which part of the prompt reduces made-up content?

help: "Use only these facts" reduces made-up content, but doesn't remove it. The edit step still matters.
No placeholders in graded work: replace [Insert Name] with your own name.

activities.slide: Try it: Designer on two slides
activities.title: Improve two slides with the AI layout assistant
activities.intro: Lab 4 needs at least two slides improved by the AI layout assistant, with the core text unchanged. Good candidates: your chart slide and your title slide.

items: Before: take a screenshot of the slide (Win + Shift + S).
Apply: Home › Designer, choose a layout. Google Slides: Gemini, if available. Canva: try another layout.
Check: read every word against your original. Same title? Same numbers? Chart not cropped?
Do the same for a second slide.

blocks.prompt: At least how many slides must the AI layout assistant improve for Lab 4?
After Designer changes a slide, what do you check? Pick all that apply.
Your PC has no AI layout tool. What do you try first?
options: PowerPoint for the web with a free Microsoft account
Draw the layout by hand in Paint

blocks.prompt: Optional: your before and after screenshots

help: Designer needs internet and a signed-in Microsoft account.
Older PowerPoint? Look for Design › Design Ideas.
Designer says "no ideas"? Try a slide with less text.
Still stuck? Tell the facilitator in the chat and you'll find a fallback together.

activities.title: Quick check: Designer shortened your title

blocks.prompt: Designer changed your title "Office Supplies Inventory, 3rd Quarter" to "Inventory". What do you do?
options: Keep it; the design looks better
Undo or pick another design, then confirm the full title
Delete the slide and start over
Add an animation so no one notices

activities.title: Lab 4: Multimedia Presentation and Ethical Design
activities.intro: Build a deck of at least 5 slides and present it in 5 minutes. Default scenario: "My Digital Skills Journey", what you learned from Module 1 to Module 4. You may instead present your Lab 3 Office Supplies Inventory, or pitch a community project such as a barangay clean-up drive. Lab 4 is 30% of the final grade.

blocks.prompt: Which scenario did you choose? (My Digital Skills Journey, Lab 3 inventory, or a community project)

items: At least 5 slides with a consistent theme or background.
Varied layouts, e.g. Title slide and Title & Content.
Your Lab 3 chart or Lab 1 image, placed cleanly.
AI layout improvement on 2+ slides, core text unchanged.
Transitions that work, applied uniformly.
Also check: no [placeholders], sample data only, AI images labelled, and credits for any clip or music.

blocks.prompt: Upload your deck: Lab 4 - Lastname - My Digital Skills Journey.pptx (or .odp)
Used Google Slides? Paste the link here (set to "Anyone with the link: Viewer")

criteria.name: Content and sequence: 5+ slides in a clear order; true, specific content; no placeholders
Design and readability: one theme, varied layouts, readable fonts, short text
Media integration: Lab 3 chart or Lab 1 image placed cleanly; any clip plays
AI layout, accurate text: 2+ slides improved with the AI assistant; text and numbers unchanged
Transitions: one transition, applied uniformly, working in Slide Show
Ethics: honest visuals, credits given, AI images labelled, no personal data

help: Save often with Ctrl+S. Four hours of work and a brownout is a painful combination.
Keep your before/after screenshots of the AI slides; they make a great talking point.
Plan about 45 to 60 seconds per slide and rehearse once with a timer.
